name: Chuck Schumer
office: U.S. Senator from New York; Senate Democratic Leader
stance: Wants serious federal guardrails on frontier AI and has demanded the administration brief all senators on frontier-model testing and AI risks.

statements.text: We do not know what artificial intelligence will be capable of two years from now, 50 years from now, 100 years from now, in the hands of foreign adversaries, especially autocracies, or domestic rebel groups interested in extortionist financial gain or political upheaval. The dangers of AI could be extreme. We need to do everything we can to instill guardrails that make sure these groups cannot use our advances in AI for illicit and bad purpose.
First, I asked everyone in the room, ‘Is government needed to play a role in regulating AI?’ and every single person raised their hands even though they had diverse views,
Giving China access to this premier US technology is dangerous and threatens our lead in the AI race that will shape the global economy for decades.
Demanded an immediate classified all-senators briefing from the Trump administration on its frontier AI testing framework, AI chip export controls, and defence against AI-enabled cyberattacks.
Warning bells are ringing louder than they ever have – and the Trump administration is looking the other way.
We cannot afford to turn a blind eye to AI. The warning signs have never been clearer.
We need a full accounting of their framework for testing AI models.
The unchecked danger of catastrophic risks from AI is a serious problem that demands action.

We've heard nothing but crickets over a week after I called for a classified Senate briefing on AI risks, including cybersecurity and stopping the flow of AI chips and manufacturing equipment to China.
